## Validation and limitations

The query returned **20,244 records** through the required **2020-11-22 Entrez-date bound**; no publication-date limit was added. Relative recall was **11/11 (100%)** in the development set and **4/4 (100%)** in the semi-independent held-out set. These small, internally discovered sets do not estimate absolute sensitivity or external benchmark recall.

The outcome block reduced the exposure-only count by 85.7%, but the final count exceeds the 10,000-record standard workload budget. Two category probes found no eligible records, but they predate the final exposure-term additions; this residual coverage risk was accepted provisionally and is documented in the audit.
